records.source_Japanese:
動物のツノじゃな。
漢方薬として重宝されると聞く
records.current_English:
An animal horn prized as Chinese
  medicine.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Twisted Horn. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: The adviser recognizes an animal horn and has heard that it is prized in Chinese medicine.
records.english: An animal horn. I hear it's prized in Chinese medicine.
records.localization_note: Keep the identification, the cultural reference and the adviser’s attribution.

records.source_Japanese:
なんとも言いがたいパワーを
秘めておるのう
信頼のおける勇者に
持たせるべきじゃな
records.current_English:
A proven hero should bear its
  strange power.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing King's Shield. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: The adviser senses an indescribable power in the shield and recommends giving it to a reliable warrior.
records.english: There's a power in this I can't put into words. I'd entrust it to a warrior you can count on.
records.localization_note: Give the reaction room before the recommendation and keep the emphasis on trust.

records.source_Japanese:
これだけの品には
なかなか巡り会えんわい
信頼のおける勇者に
持たせるべきじゃな
records.current_English:
Such a treasure is rarely seen.
  Entrust it to a proven hero.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Giant Red Spear. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: The adviser rarely sees a piece of such quality and recommends giving it to a reliable warrior.
records.english: You don't often come across a piece this fine. I'd entrust it to a warrior you can count on.
records.localization_note: Preserve the rare quality of the spear and match the parallel recommendation for the shield.

records.source_Japanese:
秘宝の場所を記した古の地図の断片じゃ
四枚で一組となるそうじゃ
records.current_English: Old map piece; four make a set.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Flame Gem Map 1. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: It is a fragment of an old map marking the hidden treasure’s location. Four fragments reportedly make a set.
records.english: A piece of an old map to a hidden treasure. I hear it takes four pieces to make a set.
records.localization_note: Restore the treasure clue and the reported four-piece set for part 1 of the Flame Gem map. Match the other fragments because the adviser gives the same clue for each.
